entries.shortDefinition: An individual proof with its claim, statement, and binding metadata.
entries.distinction: An unproven requirement, planned proof role, UTxO, validator, or signature alone is not a Strand.

entries.shortDefinition: The reusable definition of an assertion, its subject, premises, and intended relation.
entries.distinction: Defining the requirement does not produce a proof instance.

entries.shortDefinition: Composing required proofs under an explicit consumer acceptance rule.
entries.distinction: Composition alone establishes neither aggregation, recursion, nor execution.

entries.shortDefinition: A concrete cryptographic artifact for an identified statement and relation under named assumptions.
entries.distinction: A reusable definition or illustrated proof role is not that artifact.
A financial duty is a liability or continuing performance requirement.

entries.shortDefinition: A ledger output representing a claim under an identified policy.
entries.distinction: It is neither the proof nor its validator.

entries.shortDefinition: Actual target-ledger acceptance of authorized effects under the applicable conditions.
entries.distinction: Illustrative assembly, proof collection, and submission do not establish settlement.

copy.heroTitle: Bring the required proofs to the transition.
copy.heroBody: Make the handoff from financial requirements to concrete proofs and the consuming script explicit. Keep exact assets, recipients, authority, fees, and remaining duties in view.

copy.illustrationCaption: Planned proof roles, shown for explanation. These nodes are requirements for future proof instances, not actual Strands or evidence of independent proof producers. A complete illustration means only illustrative assembly.
copy.partialPaymentCaption: Illustrative worksheet: paying 35 CASH plus a separate 2 CASH fee debits escrow by 37. Invoice duty falls from 100 to 65; reserve duty stays 10. Funding 110 leaves cash 73 against duties 75. Proposed funding 112 backs one partial only.
